overclaims: Together, these disclosures support the claim under the contract's reading of changing business economics (e1).
checks.note: The support condition needs an explicit change in how Anthropic invests or pays for infrastructure. The only quoted filing text is the growth-decline warning, which comes close to the generic warnings the contradiction condition rules out. The leased chips, facilities and advance payments appear only in the collector's explanation, not in quoted S-1 text. Calling them 'disclosures' that together support the claim says more than the evidence shows, though the limitations admit the gap. The evidence excerpt drops 'We expect', which is minor.
